# It's God, Yo!

It's God, Yo! is a parent-paid daily scripture text service for teens, operated by Deckard Enterprise International, LLC. Each English message is grounded in the public-domain King James Version and rewritten as a short, casual text. A recipient must personally reply YES before the subscription activates. Plans include individual, family, gift, and group or church options.
